messages:
Olga Ivanova: hey team! i'm olga, starting today on infra. remote in NYC but visiting SF next month. quick q: anyone up for a pancake/recipe swap? also huge kdrama fan — any recs? and commute tip: folding bike + muni — yay or nay? :wave: :pancakes:

Marta Chen: welcome @Olga! :wave: we have a pancake spreadsheet + toppings channel. ping me and i'll add you. kdrama rec: 'Crash Landing on You' — classic. folding bike + muni = yes, there are 2 good spots to stash near 2nd & mission.

Leo Park: also fyi we do a monthly 'snack swap' (not only pancakes). bring something once in office and drop it on microkitchen table. :pancakes:

Harper Lin: kdrama recs: 'Signal' for thriller, 'Hometown Cha Cha Cha' for coziness. if you're into food shows, 'Chef & My Fridge' is hilarious. also @Juno can help with folding bike storage.

Juno (Facilities): hey @Olga — welcome! we have two fold-bike racks in the bike room; send me your badge # and i'll grant temporary access. there's a small repair kit in 1st floor closet. :wrench:

Sam (People Ops): welcome! we'll add you to the Pancake Party calendar. also FYI we host an off-hours watch party sometimes — check #watercooler for next one. :calendar:

Kira (NYC): fwiw i commute w/ folding bike + PATH, works great. pro tip: buy a quick-release cable lock — less hassle on trains. also welcome! :biking_man:
